item.title: Why good design fails inside most companies
item.description: Companies lose insight into customers in the handoffs between those gathering insights and those shipping the product. Most companies believe they understand their customers. They run research, track behavior, and gather feedback at scale. Yet products still reach the market feeling disconnected from the way people actually live. The original insight was there. It just became a little less clear each time it passed from one team to the next....
